description.text: No Cost Educational Resources Act of 2025 This bill authorizes the Institute of Museum and Library Services to award grants to institutions of higher education (IHEs) for facilitating the adoption, adaption, and creation of open educational reading materials and establishing more open educational reading material courses. Open educational reading material refers to a free digital text that is publicly available to be downloaded and redistributed. Open educational reading material course refers to a science, technology, engineering, or math course offered by an IHE that uses only open educational reading materials as the form of the required readings for the course.

latestAction.text: Referred to the House Committee on Education and Workforce.

bill.title: No Cost Educational Resources Act of 2025

aiDescription.summary: The bill allows IMLS to award grants to colleges and universities to adopt, adapt, or create free downloadable "open educational reading materials" and to offer STEM courses using only those materials. Applications must be led by librarians with STEM faculty collaboration and prioritize institutions serving many low‑income or minority students.

impact.summary: The bill allows the Institute of Museum and Library Services to award grants to U.S. colleges and universities to create and adopt free digital open educational reading materials for STEM courses. It affects librarians, STEM faculty, students (especially low income or minority), and textbook publishers.
